caption: The drawing depicts a single stylized rooster in profile facing to the right. The rooster is rendered in shades of brown with darker accent lines outlining its form and wing feathers. The rooster’s eye is depicted using a distinct red color with a dark center. Its comb and beak are visible, and it stands on a short base that suggests a simplified or sculptural form rather than a naturalistic depiction. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery included. The signature “Handden Brown” appears on the lower left side of the drawing.
title: Weather Vane
